expertise.label: Expertise
expertise.description: I work across frontend, backend, AI and product. I like to understand the problem before the first line of code, and to ship something that works in the real world without a manual.

uniquadra.category: My first project in college: a system to book sports courts at Unifor.
uniquadra.details: This was my first big project, built in college. The idea was to bring Unifor's sports catalog, court bookings and digital student card into one place. I worked on the Node.js back end, with the code split into classes so each one had a single job.
highlights: Sports catalog and court bookings in one place
Digital card issued by the system
Node.js back end with object-oriented code

farminghabit.category: A habit app that plays like a game: farm pixel art, a consistency heatmap and progress that makes you want to come back tomorrow.
farminghabit.details: FarmingHabit is mine: a habit app with a farming RPG theme. I drew the pixel art, built the consistency heatmap and the progression system, and used Supabase for sign-in and sync so people pick up where they left off on any device.
highlights: Farm pixel art drawn by me

prisma.category: I led three developers on a psychometric (IAT) testing tool and talked to the people using it before every release.
prisma.details: At PRISMA, a research tool built around IAT tests, I led a team of three developers and wrote full-stack code with them. Much of the job was talking to the people who would use it: listening to their questions, working out what was missing, and bringing that back to the team before the next release.
highlights: Led three developers through the full-stack build
Direct conversations with users to find what was missing
Research software built around IAT tests
